title: Implement Parameterized Queries
problem_statement: VB6 application uses concatenated SQL strings creating SQL injection vulnerabilities
risk_if_unaddressed: Critical security vulnerability allowing unauthorized data access and manipulation
suggested_approach: Replace concatenated SQL with parameterized queries using Command objects with Parameters collection
success_criteria: All SQL operations use parameterized queries
Static analysis confirms no string concatenation in SQL statements

provenance.evidence: ADO 2.0 Library reference indicates direct SQL usage

title: Extract Business Logic from UI Forms
problem_statement: Business rules embedded in VB6 form event handlers are not testable or reusable
risk_if_unaddressed: Business logic loss during modernization, reduced maintainability, no unit testing capability
suggested_approach: Create separate business logic classes and move validation/calculation logic from form events
success_criteria: Business logic separated into testable classes
Form events only handle UI interactions
Unit tests cover all business rules

title: MS Access to PostgreSQL Migration Strategy
problem_statement: Database migration from MS Access to PostgreSQL requires schema conversion and data type mapping
risk_if_unaddressed: Data loss, performance degradation, application compatibility issues
suggested_approach: Use automated migration tools with manual validation for complex data types and relationships
success_criteria: Complete schema migration with preserved relationships
Performance benchmarks meet or exceed current system

provenance.evidence: ADO reference suggests MS Access backend

title: Implement Comprehensive Agent Testing
problem_statement: Python agent system lacks comprehensive unit and integration testing coverage
risk_if_unaddressed: Unreliable modernization results, difficult debugging, regression introduction
suggested_approach: Implement pytest-based testing with mocking for external dependencies and comprehensive coverage reporting
success_criteria: 90%+ code coverage across all agent modules
Integration tests for all API endpoints

provenance.evidence: Complex agent with 25 imports needs comprehensive testing
